programme.title: WSL Inside Pro Surfing
programme.sub-title: Inside Pro Surfing - Lexus Tahiti Pro presented by I-SEA 2025
programme.desc: More than a Championship Tour event, the Lexus Tahiti Pro presented by I-SEA will be a reckoning on the 2025 World Title race. It's the last chance for surfers looking to clinch their spot in the WSL Final 5, defend their place in the rankings, or even rewrite a season. The beauty of Teahupo'o is how it disguises its brutality. In Tahiti, it's no longer about surviving the season. It's about earning the right to fight for a World Title.

programme.title: WSL Replay
programme.sub-title: REPLAY | All the Action from the Surf City El Salvador Pro 2025
programme.desc: Where the Pacific's perfect right-hand point break meets an unparalleled competition venue, the Surf City El Salvador Pro delivers an opportunity for CT athletes to earn critical points in the rankings ahead of the Mid-season Cut. Long, powerful walls offer endless opportunity for progressive maneuvers while the hollow sections demand split-second decision-making that can test even the most seasoned CT competitor. Replay all the action of Final's Day at Punta Roca.

programme.desc: The Hawaiian leg of the WSL World Tour has arrived. For Lakey Peterson to still have a shot at the World Title, she has to win the final event of the women's tour's season, the Beachwaver Maui Pro — then beat Stephanie Gilmore in a surf off. For Julian Wilson, it all comes down to Pipeline, where he's been crowned a Pipe Master before. The pressure is on as All In approaches its final episodes.
